title: Scientific Method
use: Philosophical orientation: methodology is contested and plural; no single recipe is imposed across every discipline.
coverage: Firecrawl targeted answer; not the full entry. No extracted quotation is reproduced as a verified literal quote.

title: PRISMA 2020
use: Reporting guideline, checklists and flow diagrams for systematic reviews. Reporting is distinct from conduct and validity.
coverage: Official overview page text read. Linked statement and elaboration papers were not read in full for this guide.

title: PRISMA extension for scoping reviews
use: Scoping reviews map evidence/concepts and use a distinct reporting extension, PRISMA-ScR.
coverage: Official extension page text read; checklist PDFs and linked papers not read in full.

title: Chapter 4: Searching for and selecting studies
use: Search coverage, sources, documentation and selection. This is intervention-review guidance; not a universal method for every field.
coverage: Search excerpts and focused Firecrawl extraction; not the entire handbook.

title: Preregistration
use: Distinguish planned confirmatory analyses from valuable exploratory work; report deviations transparently.
coverage: Selected FAQ passages/search excerpts and targeted extraction, not every linked study.

title: ASA statement on statistical significance and p-values — release notice
use: Six principles: p-values are not posterior hypothesis probabilities, effect size, practical importance or substitutes for reasoning.
coverage: All three pages of the official notice extracted/read. The separate journal statement and commentaries were not all read.

title: Confidence limits for the mean
use: Frequentist confidence intervals and their long-run interpretation under assumptions.
coverage: Page text read. Extracted mathematical layout was imperfect; the guide does not copy its mangled equations.

title: Standards for reporting qualitative research (SRQR)
use: Locate appropriate qualitative reporting guidance; reporting standards are not a universal epistemology or proof of quality.
coverage: Registry page read; not a claim of full reading of O’Brien et al.’s underlying paper.

title: The Belmont Report
use: Respect for persons, beneficence and justice in human-subject research. Local institutional/jurisdictional rules still apply.
coverage: Selected principles and applications through Firecrawl extraction/search passages; not a legal or ethics-approval determination.

title: The FAIR Guiding Principles
use: Findability, accessibility, interoperability, reuse, provenance and licenses; authorization may be needed, not universally required.
coverage: Full principles page text read after checking an overbroad generated extraction.

title: Artifact Review and Badging v1.1
use: Separate artifact availability/evaluation from results validation; define reproduction/replication in the policy’s own terms.
coverage: Policy text was read earlier in this conversation; version rechecked through Firecrawl here. No badge is awarded by this handbook.

title: Validating a Lean Proof
use: Trusted targets, statement correspondence, transitive axioms, incomplete proofs and checker trust boundaries.
coverage: Relevant official sections read earlier in this conversation and targeted extraction revisited here. No proof tool was executed.

title: Contributor Role Taxonomy
use: Fourteen contributor roles make different contributions visible; use the relevant separate authorship policy.
coverage: Official resource hub page read. Linked role pages and every venue’s authorship policy were not individually reviewed.

title: Approaches to Research
use: Introductory orientation to study approaches, surveys, cases and longitudinal/cross-sectional designs.
coverage: Focused Firecrawl extraction only; not the full book. Introductory generalizations are not treated as universal guarantees.

title: Analyzing Findings
use: Introductory distinctions among association, assignment, measurement reliability and validity.
coverage: Focused extraction. Its overbroad experiment-only causal phrasing was not adopted; see the specialist causal source S16.

title: Causal inference in statistics: An overview
use: Causal/counterfactual inference combines data with explicit assumptions; identification and estimation are distinct operations.
coverage: First three PDF pages only: abstract, contents and introduction (printed pp. 96–98), not all 51 pages. DOI 10.1214/09-SS057 confirmed in the source.
